title: Streaking and Isolating Bacteria on a LB Agar Plate
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8euhtew

steps.title: Prepare and Label LB Agar Plate
steps.instruction: Obtain an LB agar plate with appropriate antibiotic (if any) and label the bottom of the plate.

substeps.instruction: Label the bottom with the strain name and the date.
Add antibiotic resistance (if any) and initials.

steps.title: Sterilize Work Area
steps.instruction: Prepare the lab bench for sterile work.

substeps.instruction: Spray the bench with 70% ethanol and wipe with a paper towel.
Maintain sterility by working near a flame or bunsen burner.

steps.title: Retrieve Bacterial Stock
steps.instruction: Obtain the bacteria of interest from the bacterial stock database and retrieve the glycerol stock from the -80C freezer (Freezer 6- Bacterial Stock box).

steps.title: Collect Bacteria
steps.instruction: Use a sterile pipette tip to touch the top of the glycerol stock to obtain the bacteria on the tip.

steps.title: Streak the Plate
steps.instruction: Perform a three-stage streak to dilute the bacteria and obtain single colonies.

substeps.instruction: Gently spread the bacteria over a section of the plate to create streak #1.
Using a fresh, sterile pipette tip, drag through streak #1 and spread over a second section to create streak #2.
Using a third sterile pipette tip, drag through streak #2 and spread over the last section to create streak #3.

steps.title: Incubate the Plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate lid side down overnight (generally 12-18 hours) at the appropriate growth temperature for the particular strain.

substeps.instruction: Ensure incubation does not exceed the recommended duration for antibiotic resistant plasmids to prevent bacteria from metabolising the antibiotic.

steps.title: Verify Single Colony Growth
steps.instruction: Check for the presence of single colonies (appearing as white dots).

substeps.instruction: If bacterial growth is too dense and single colonies are not visible, re-streak onto a new agar plate.

steps.title: Store Plates
steps.instruction: Store the streaked plates at 4C, lid side down to avoid condensation falling on the single colonies.

substeps.instruction: Plates can be used for up to a month to make liquid cultures.
